FieldAddOut.description: A select whose list can take a new entry on the spot (the «+ нэмэх» line); null when it cannot.
FieldAddOut.title: FieldAddOut

LeaveLoadedOut.description: The row as the edit and cancel pop-ups loaded it; sent back unchanged so a save refuses a row someone changed.
LeaveLoadedOut.title: LeaveLoadedOut

LeaveRequestFormIn.description: The staff request form as posted. There is no employee: the own record is always used.
LeaveRequestFormIn.title: LeaveRequestFormIn

LeaveWriteIn.description: The add and edit forms as posted. Every box may be empty: React sends null, and the form gives its own texts.
LeaveWriteIn.title: LeaveWriteIn

RecruitFileOut.description: A CV or other file. The stored path is never sent: the download is a plain link to the file's own address.
RecruitFileOut.title: RecruitFileOut

RecruitVacancyFormOut.description: The vacancy edit pop-up's first values: the ids the form posts back (names are on the vacancy page).
RecruitVacancyFormOut.title: RecruitVacancyFormOut

RecruitVacancyIn.description: The vacancy pop-up as posted: ids as numbers (null when blank), dates as YYYY-MM-DD text ("" when blank).
RecruitVacancyIn.title: RecruitVacancyIn

RecruitWriteResultOut.description:
The answer of every recruitment write: ok true, or ok false with the service's message (error) or the form's
errors (field_errors, form_errors). The same shape as the leave writes; a refused write changes nothing.
RecruitWriteResultOut.title: RecruitWriteResultOut

get.description: The attention box for the signed-in user, as the Today page builds it (only employees with an HR row).
The items of one Анхаарах group past the first GROUP_LIMIT, or a page of a gap group with `all=1`.

post.description: "Мэдлээ" / "Дахин харуулах" on one Анхаарах item or a whole group; answers with the box.

«Ажлаас гарах жагсаалт эхлүүлэх» with the picked last day. 404 for a hidden employee or without the start right,
400 for a bad date or when no template applies, 409 when refused.

get.description: «Миний даалгавар»: the signed-in user's own open tasks, earliest due first. Works without an employee record.

post.description: «Хийгдсэн» on a checklist task the user owns (404 when the user may not tick it, 409 when it is refused).
«Буцаах»: undo the tick of a checklist task (404 without the manage right, 409 when refused).
«Цуцлах»: cancel an open checklist (404 without the manage right, 409 when refused).

get.description: The company figures page (403 without the employee-list right, as company_page).

post.description:
Hire a new employee from the add form, the same hire as the Django page. `values` is a JSON object of HTML name
-> string (every box, a checkbox as "on" or absent); `candidate` and `submission` are the hidden values the form
posts back. A refused or invalid form answers 200 with ok false and nothing is written. 403 without the manage
right, 400 for malformed values, 401 without a login.

get.description:
The employee already under this register number, if the user may see them (the live check on the hire page).
The number is normalised the way the save normalises it; an empty one looks nobody up.

The district options of the city, as the hire page's district select shows them. No or an unknown city has no
district, so the list is empty.

The hire form's layout, fields and gating. `candidate` and `submission` are the recruitment candidate and the
self-form HR hires from; the other query values prefill the forms (the recruitment «Ажилд авах» link). A bad or
foreign id is ignored. 403 without the manage right.

`{number, date}` for the «Санал болгох» button: the next number of the year of `date` (else today) and the date
to use when the form's date is still empty. A bad or empty date means today.
The header, rail and rights of one employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise).

One batch of the «Түүх» drawer for an employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise), as activity_more:
50 entries from `offset` (a junk offset is 0), the day heading of the entry above, and the next offset.

The cancel pop-up. 404 when the event is not cancellable (applied, cancelled) or is not the employee's; 403
without the right to cancel it.

post.description:
Cancel the event. A refused form (no reason, a signed order without its cancel order number) answers 200 with
ok false and changes nothing.

Record the change. A refused or invalid form answers 200 with ok false and nothing is written; on success the
MACS number-clash note is kept for the next employee page. For a refused save with an unreal date, the hidden
`prev_effective` must travel inside `values` (the key "prev_effective"), as the page posts it, so the response keeps
the last real date.

The event form's state for the values typed so far. 404 for an unknown type or an employee outside the user's
scope, 403 without the right to record this type. Nothing is written.
Correct one job row; the reason is required. A refused correction answers 200 with ok false.

get.description: The pop-up to correct one job row (403 without the manage right or for a scheduled row).

post.description:
Create the employee's login and answer its temporary password once (no-store). An invalid username is a 400
with field_errors["username"]; a refused creation (a second login, a taken name) is a 400 with form_errors.
Add a note to the employee's activity log (a manager's right; 404 outside the user's scope, 403 without it).

get.description:
The cancel pop-up of a registered order with no change behind it (the reason). 404 for a change's order, a
signed or pending one; 403 without the manage right.

post.description:
Cancel the order with the posted reason. A missing reason answers 200 with ok false on the `reason` field; a
service refusal answers 200 with ok false as a form error. Nothing is written then.

get.description: The whole order pop-up. Anyone who may see the employee may open it; the buttons follow the user's rights.
The order filled from its Word template, as .docx (a draft to print and sign). 403 without the manage right.
The same order as a PDF. 403 without the manage right; a cancelled order is 404.

The edit pop-up with the saved values (or a suggested number). 404 for a signed or cancelled order; 403 without
the manage right.

post.description:
Save the edit. A refused form answers 200 with ok false and changes nothing; a saved order keeps the MACS
number-clash note for the next employee page.

get.description: The signed scan of the order. Hire and rehire scans need the salary right (403 without it).

Who created, registered, edited, signed or cancelled this order, and when. Needs only the right to see the
employee (no manage right).

The signing pop-up's data: the title with the order's number, and whether the user has a saved signature. 403
without the signing switch or for a hire order whose salary the user may not see; 404 when not registered.

post.description:
Sign the registered order (saved or drawn). A refusal that writes nothing answers 200 with ok false and the
messages; the signing is not wrapped in a transaction here (the service makes its own).

get.description: The signature picture of a signed order. Anyone who may see the employee may see it; not logged.
The upload pop-up: one file box (multipart). 403 without the manage right.

post.description:
Attach the signed scan. A missing, wrong or too big file, or an order that is not registered, answers 200 with
ok false and the message on the form; nothing is attached then. Uploads keep no MACS note.

get.description:
The header, work and bank fields and the salary fields of one employee the user may see, with their stored
values (404 outside the user's scope; 403 without the manage or the salary right).

The personal tab of one employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise; 403 without the personal right):
the topic groups with their chips, the four field sections, and the personal lists.

post.description:
Save one section of the personal tab (the same save as the Django section form). Business outcomes answer
200 with the result; an unknown section is 404, a user without the manage and personal rights is 403.
Add one row of a personal list. A refused form answers 200 with ok false; an unknown list is 404.

get.description:
The pop-up of one personal-list row: an add form (no key) or the edit form of the row `key`. An address takes
city, district and street as presets so the district choices follow the city (the Django pop-up's rule).

post.description:
Change one row of a personal list if it still matches the loaded values posted back (a changed row answers
200 with ok false and the message in form_errors). Missing loaded values: 400, nothing written; unknown row: 404.
Delete one row of a personal list, on the loaded values posted back (same rules as the edit).

get.description:
The Salary tab of one employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise; 403 without the salary right):
today's pay, the pay history rows and the «Банк, даатгал» block.

post.description: Set the first salary and write its activity entry. A refused form answers 200 with ok false.

get.description:
The pop-up to set the first salary (404 outside the user's scope; 403 without the salary right or once a salary
exists).

post.description: Correct one salary row; the reason is required. A refused correction answers 200 with ok false.

get.description: The pop-up to correct one salary row (403 for a scheduled row; 404 for another employee's row).

post.description:
Save what the user may change on the employee page. `values_json` is a JSON object of HTML name -> string
(the fields, `loaded`, `si-loaded` and any `resolve-<name>`). Business outcomes answer 200 with the result.

Tick or untick one setup item (Бүрдүүлэлт) while the employee's checklist is open. 403 without the manage right
or once the checklist is closed; a system item answers 400.

get.description:
The Work tab of one employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise): job, contract, MACS fields, the
history, the waiting changes, the other orders, the leave block and the checklist panels.
One batch of the leave list, newest first. Unknown or junk filter values are dropped, as on the Django page.

post.description: Record a leave (the add pop-up). The same form and service as the Django add view.

get.description: One batch of the balances page: the visible, still-working people in name order, with their current period.
One month of the team calendar. Junk or an out-of-range month is the current month; junk department is none.

post.description:
The live check of the form as posted: working days, the period and the balance after. An invalid form answers
valid false with empty lists; a leave_id the user may not see is ignored (check_for).

get.description: The holidays of one year. Junk or an out-of-range year is this year.

post.description: Set one date's holiday name. The refusal text of the Django page comes back in `error`.
Remove one date from the holidays. A bad date or a day not listed changes nothing and is still ok.
Add the fixed-date holidays that are still missing from the year.

get.description: The choices of the add pop-up and its first values. `from=assistant` adds the assistant's two lines.
One batch of the requests list. `tab=all` needs leave.view_leave; any other tab is the user's own queue.

post.description: Submit a leave request for the user's own record. The same form and service as the Django request view.

The live preview of the request form: days, the period, the balance after and the overlaps. An invalid form
answers valid false with empty lists. Nothing is written.

get.description: The types the staff request form offers (active, and staff may request them).
The detail pop-up of one request. 404 unless the user may act on it or may see the person's leave.

post.description:
Approve the current step. The last step writes the leave. A step that is not the one the screen was opened at
is refused (STEP_MOVED), as the Django view's expected step.
Reject the request at the current step. The reason is required; no leave is written.

get.description: The leave types, the approval steps with their choices, and the auto-grant switch.

post.description: Save the two approval steps. An unknown choice is refused under its field; step 2 is empty when step 1 is.
Switch the automatic annual grant on or off.
Add a leave type. The same form and service as the Django add pop-up.

get.description: One leave type as the pop-up loads it. 404 for an unknown id.

post.description: Change a leave type's name and settings. 404 for an unknown id.
Remove a leave type no leave or entitlement uses; a type in use is kept and the reason comes back in `error`.

get.description: The edit pop-up's first values and the row as loaded. 404 for a leave the user may not see.

post.description:
Change a recorded leave. A missing or malformed `loaded` or a row another program changed is refused as stale.
404 for a leave the user may not see (the rights are checked first: 403 for a user who may not record).

get.description: What the cancel pop-up asks. 404 for a leave the user may not see.

post.description:
Cancel a leave: one not started yet is removed, one that has started is marked «Буруу бүртгэсэн». The same rules
and messages as the Django cancel view. 404 for a leave the user may not see.
Set each meaning to the chosen entry; an empty choice deletes it, a junk or unknown pk changes nothing.
Add an entry to a list. Refused (ok false, status 200, nothing written) when the form is invalid.

get.description: The add pop-up with no pk, the edit pop-up with one. The rights are checked before the entry is looked up.

post.description: Pick the entry with the same name, or create it, for a form dropdown. A form error answers 400.
Change entry `pk`; 404 for an unknown or junk pk. The same refusals as the add.
Delete entry `pk`. An entry still in use is refused (ok false, the in-use text, the entry stays).

get.description: One batch of the employee log, newest first unless `oldest`. Unknown or junk filter values are dropped.
The employee log as an Excel file: every row the screen shows for this address. Needs view and export rights.
One batch of the system log, newest first unless `oldest`. Unknown or junk filter values are dropped.
The system log as an Excel file: every row the screen shows for this address. Needs audit and export rights.
The My page of the signed-in user (its own record only; 404 without an employee record).

post.description: «Мэдлээ» on one result notice. Only a notice of the user's own request can be dismissed (404 otherwise).
«Буцаах»: the user takes back their own waiting request. Someone else's request is 404; a refused change 409.

get.description: The signed-in user's own saved signature picture (only ever their own; 404 when none). Not logged.

post.description: Delete the user's own saved signature. Answers ok; the page refreshes its own query.

get.description: Every matching row, grouped by department, as the print page draws it. Writes one export log line.

post.description:
The ticked orders as one PDF, one order per page. Form-encoded `ids` so a plain form can post them; each
printed order is logged like a single download.
Start the ticked orders' PDF as a background job (11 orders or more); the page polls the job's status.

get.description: The job's PDF once it is ready. 404 until then, and for another user's or an unknown job.
The job's state. Only the user who started it may read it (404 otherwise, and for an unknown token).

The palette's groups for the typed query. `more` is «show all» only when it is "1"; `recent` and `from` are
re-checked by the service.
The candidate page: the person, the progress, the actions the user may take, the history, comments and files.

post.description: Add a comment. Any user who sees the candidate may comment, so no manage right is asked.

The hire form's address for this candidate (prefilled), or the refusal text. Writes nothing; the link is made
only when the hire is saved.
Attach a CV (multipart field `file`). The file's type, size and emptiness are checked by files.save.
Move a candidate to the next or another open stage. The service's refusal text comes back in `error`.
Reject a candidate, or record that they withdrew. A missing reason is a field error under `reason`.
Reopen a rejected or withdrawn candidate as new.

get.description:
The CV itself, under its original name; any user who sees the candidate may download it. A stored file that is
missing is 404. The response is the file, not JSON, so it has no response schema.
The rejected or withdrawn candidates the purge would remove today, and the retention period.

post.description: Delete the rejected or withdrawn candidates past the retention period and their files (403 without the right).

get.description: One batch of the vacancy list: the visible vacancies with the chosen status and the search words.

post.description: Add a vacancy (open, created by the user). 403 without the manage right; the new vacancy's id comes back.

get.description: The choices of the vacancy form. With `vacancy`, the edit form's choices: its manager and the statuses.

The budget line for the position, branch and start picked in the vacancy form. Junk headcount is 1, junk ids
and dates are none; the answer is null when the line is not shown (no position, the slot switch off).
The vacancy page: the vacancy, its stage bar and one batch of its candidates. A later batch repeats the body.

post.description: Change a vacancy. 404 for one the user may not see, then 403 without the manage right.
Add a candidate to an open vacancy. A closed or filled vacancy is refused with the Django text first.

get.description:
The edit pop-up's values as the form posts them back: 404 for a vacancy the user may not see, then 403 without
the manage right (as the edit route).
The «Засах» pop-up with the view's own values.

post.description: Renames the view and changes who sees it and whether it opens first. The query is not used on an edit.
Deletes the view (its author or a manager). The redirect is the bare report.

get.description:
The report's head, filter bar and table layout for the address. The redirect is answered before the table is
built, as the Django page does. A layout other than the table answers the head, the bar and the layout page (its
payload) with no table.

One batch of the cards layout for the address (the same cards the page draws). The address must name the
cards layout, else 404 «not_found» (no cards to batch). The table is built without its filter bar, as rows is.
The «Багана сонгох» pop-up's model for the address.
The «Хэлбэр» pop-up's model for the address.
One batch of the table for the address (every row of a grouped table, with next_offset None).
The «Шүүлтүүр» pop-up's model for the address.

post.description: Stores the cleaned address under the posted name. The redirect is the saved view's address.

get.description: The «Хадгалах» pop-up: the address the viewer is looking at, to be stored under a name.

The list rows (newest first, in the user's scope), the waiting count and the create form's description.
403 without the manage right, 401 without a login.

post.description:
Create an employee self-form link. Refused (ok false, status 200) when the form is invalid or the service
refuses the create; nothing is written then. 403 without the manage right.

get.description:
One self-form link with its state, the link itself (a secret, so the answer is no-store) and the HR decision.
403 without the manage right, 404 (code not_found) outside the user's scope.

post.description:
Add hours to an open or expired link. A refusal (bad hours, not open, purged) answers ok false with the
service's text and writes nothing. 403 without the manage right, 404 outside the user's scope.

HR rejects a submitted self-form for good; the reason is kept on the invitation. A blank reason or a form that
is not waiting for HR is refused with ok false. 403 without the manage right, 404 outside the user's scope.

Cancel the link so the employee cannot fill it any more. A refusal (already revoked, confirmed, ...) answers
ok false with the service's text. 403 without the manage right, 404 outside the user's scope.

HR sends a submitted self-form back to the employee with a note. A blank note or a form that is not waiting for
HR is refused with ok false and nothing is written. 403 without the manage right, 404 outside the user's scope.
Add a slot row. Refused (ok false, status 200) when the form is invalid or the key is already held.
Change row `pk`; 404 for an unknown pk. The same refusals as the add.
Delete row `pk`; 404 for an unknown pk. A refused delete (the database login lacks the grant) is ok false.

get.description: The names of people away on one day of the Today strip (`?day=YYYY-MM-DD`, inside the 14-day window).
The names of people who joined in the last 30 days (the hires line of «Ойрын 30 хоног»).
The birthdays or the work anniversaries in the next 30 days (`?kind=birthday|anniversary`).
The report setups that say what is coming up, with their counts (empty without reports.view_reports).
